item.tib: gsang sngags nang gi lha dang srung ma'i bskul pa rmod sngags drag po srog gi sha zan snying khrag 'bar ba'i phreng ba
item.coloph: de ltar lha dang srung ma'i tshogs rnams skul cing dmod sngags drag po srog gi sha zan snying khrag 'bar ba'i dam nyams srog gi phreng ba zhes bya ba/ bstan pa'i dgra bo sgrol ba'i ched du/ dmu rgyal rnal 'byor nyi ma'i ming can gyis/ (dge sdig le'u tshan) du brtsams pa/ bstan dgra'i gshed mar shog lcags yos zla ba brgyad pa'i tshes bco brgyad la grub par bgyiso//
